name: agents
description: Shubham's personal Claude Code agents: standup-gen (plain-spoken standup summaries from your session), tech-writer + article-critic (a write/review pipeline for technical articles that read as human-written, run via the write-article skill), story-teller (true tech stories as an X post, a LinkedIn post, and an image prompt, each with a primer that teaches you the story first, run via the tell-story skill), teacher (teaches concepts and tools from the ground up with examples and diagrams), and cfp-writer (conference talk proposals researched against what the conference accepted before and against your own accepted and rejected proposals in the cfps repo, run via the write-cfp skill).
